notes: The ATW-3212 is a 3000 Series (4th Gen) UHF wireless handheld microphone system consisting of the ATW-R3210 half-rack receiver and ATW-T3202 handheld transmitter (with interchangeable ATW-C510 dynamic or ATW-C710 condenser capsule, sold as ATW-3212/C510 or ATW-3212/C710). Physical I/O documented here is the ATW-R3210 receiver's rear panel, per the official Audio-Technica user manual and submittal sheet. The two BNC antenna inputs (ANT A / ANT B) supply switchable 12V DC antenna power for powered/active antenna accessories; grade omitted since SDI/BNC video grading does not apply to RF antenna connections. The handheld transmitter (ATW-T3202) is battery-only (2x AA) with no external DC input and no separate physical audio input connector (microphone signal comes from the screw-on capsule internally), so it contributes no additional physical I/O ports to this device-level record. The receiver ships half-rack-width with rack-mount adapters/joining plate to occupy 1U when paired with a second half-rack unit; rackUnits set to 1 reflecting its standard mounting form factor. Two power supply variants exist by region (100-240V AC external adapter, output 12V DC 1A center-positive) — only the receiver's DC input jack is modeled since the AC adapter is a separate accessory (IEC/mains cord depends on region, not specified on the unit itself). Frequency band variants (DE2 470-530MHz / EE1 530-590MHz) do not affect I/O.
